summary.intent: Drive review and fixing of a stack of 14 PRs in the michi repo (release signing #117, pipeline observers #118, hygiene #119/#123, and a core chain #120-#126) via delegated subagents, ending with a merge order for the user.
summary.outcome: Fixes for #117 (dropped unworkable moon pin, corrected attestation comment) and #118 (cancel-after-save and deadline handling) were pushed; the core-chain review found defects in #120, #121, #122, #124 and #126, and three parallel fixers (F1, F2, F3) were launched. Merge order and final integration are still pending.

repo: proto 0.62.3 ignores a `moon` plugin override and uses its built-in registry plugin (moon_tool:0.4.3) even with a bogus URL, so a `[plugins]` pin cannot work; `proto-plugin.toml` was removed in a1651aa and returns 404.

Build jobs install moon via moonrepo/setup-toolchain, which runs a hardcoded moonrepo/moon master install script through a floating @v0 inside the orin-dx composite action; it cannot be pinned from michi.

All repo checks (doctests as CI runs them, nextest with and without all features, just check, pnpm build/test) passed on the core-chain head while reviewer probes still found real defects; passing checks don't cover the hostile-input and scaling cases.
Design decisions are recorded in spec docs and 06-decisions, plus changesets; behavior changes must update spec 08, the decision entry and the changeset (e.g. the new DeadlinePassed on start-save).
Core chain PRs (#120-#126) stack on non-main bases; #124's CI fails on a stale `ToonOptions::total_count` doctest that #126 fixes.

code.finding: The 16 MiB cap assumes each input byte is written at most 19 times, but the truncated table repeats the field name per cut cell (toon/table.rs:98-104) while it is charged once, giving 95x text / 112x JSON amplification and a napi string conversion failure at 60,000 rows.
The `truncated` table writes the field name again for every cut cell, which the output cap accounting does not charge.
A quoted value is counted as zero length, so `token="SECRET"` and `token='SECRET'` pass through unredacted; `authorization=Basic ...` only redacts the word 'Basic'.
An error plus an invalid section reports `toon_validation_failed` ('duplicate root key error') in text while JSON still says external_failure, hiding the caller's real error.
Comment claims the `error` object is the only error shape, but validation failures emit isError: true responses with no `error` object.
push_section_json writes the raw total, so total_count(Some(1)) on 2 rows gives JSON totalCount 1 beside returnedCount 2, while text suppresses the total.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output without user authority; verify what actually landed (e.g. git fetch and log the branch) before relaying claims.
Split parallel fixers by file ownership so their branches don't collide, and target them at the stack's integration base.
Have fixers reproduce each leak as a failing test and probe for the next class with a hostile corpus, since reviewer probes found what the CI checks could not.
A single consolidated PR to main from an integrated head avoids retargeting a multi-base stack, but closing PRs requires user approval.

friction: The branch `ci/release-signing-hardening` was checked out in another worktree, so the #117 fixer had to use a local `fix-sign` branch.
The reviewer could not read the log of the failed macOS x86_64 NAPI job on #122, so it's undiagnosed.
The #118 fixer's report wasn't visible at first, requiring a git fetch/log to confirm what was pushed.
The reviewer did not check a JS comparison of main vs head, cargo-semver-checks, fuzz targets, the full ADR index, or each PR branch individually.
open_items: Unpinned moonrepo install inside the signing job (via orin-dx composite action) remains a documented gap; needs the orin-dx/actions owner to pin/vendor it or move signing to a separate job.
Only a real release can prove the CI install path for #117.
Wait for F1/F2/F3 fixers, then run a final integration into integration/final with all checks, doctests as CI runs them, and diagnosis of the macOS x86_64 NAPI failure on #122.
User decision pending: open one consolidated PR to main and close #120-#126 as superseded.
#119 and #123 (hygiene and zig pin) remain unreviewed.

Low-severity items to fix: hints(vec) dropping status()/truncated_section hints, JsonObject::new being fallible against spec 03, the 515-byte vs 512-byte step text cap, and missing scaling cases for PartialSuccess::rows.
Surface the DeadlinePassed-during-start-save semantic change in the #118 PR body.
Merge order for all 14 PRs still to be given to the user.
